text: A nonnegative `iN` literal shall be less than `2^N`; a negative literal shall be at least `-2^(N-1)` and encoded in N-bit two's complement. Out-of-range literals shall be rejected without truncation; `[i8 255]` and `[i8 -1]` shall have equal bits.
